fy_label_note: Adjusted EBITDA margin (VA ebitda; FY2025 10.62% matches the stage 3 record). EFOR (ASGN, renamed Everforth 2026-04-24) is calendar FY, VA label = company FY. Peers RHI, CTSH, EPAM calendar; ACN (August FYE) and CACI (June FYE) use the same VA label, so their 'FY2022' is partly calendar 2021; SAIC (late January FYE) labels run one year ahead, so SAIC VA FY2023 and FY2026 were used for calendar 2022 and 2025.

company.note: FY2025 is the last full-year actual, but the decline has not ended: LTM 10.10% and FY2026 consensus 9.52%, after Q1 2026 came in at 8.6%.

peers.excluded: Kforce not tracked in Baba (companies_search returned nothing); IBM, Gartner, Amdocs, Kyndryl, DXC, Innodata, ExlService, Globant and LDOS dropped as further from ASGN's commercial IT staffing/consulting plus federal IT mix.
peers.note: Peer set is split three ways and the median is an average of different names at peak (RHI, CTSH) and trough (CACI, EPAM). Pure IT/professional staffing (RHI) fell 869 bps; offshore and large consulting (CTSH, ACN) were flat to up; federal IT (CACI, SAIC) rose. EFOR's 159 bps fall sits between the staffing and consulting groups, consistent with its mix.

deciding_facts: Over FY2022 to FY2025 the numbers read macro: peer median adjusted EBITDA margin fell 199 bps vs EFOR 159 bps (ratio 1.25), EFOR's gap to the peer median narrowed from -349 to -309 bps, and revenue fell 13.1% with margin as discretionary assignment work shrank (pure staffing peer RHI fell 869 bps).

But the compression is still running after peers stabilized (LTM 10.10%, FY2026 consensus 9.52%) and the CEO called the Q1 2026 8.6% margin a miss on company mix, on top of zero-percent achievement of 2023 internal targets; that missed target keeps it at mixed rather than macro_led.
